name: AI-Hunter.io

sources.title: Submit Your AI Tool For Free — full field list and FAQ (free, review takes 1–2 weeks, description 'must be unique content')

requirements: Submission is explicitly free ('there is no cost... completely free of charge')
AI tools (plus a 'Non AI Tools' category exists); ~60 category options
AI Tool Description 'must be unique content' — copied marketing text risks rejection
Review evaluates functionality, performance, uniqueness, and relevance; typical review takes 1–2 weeks
preparation: One category from the long list (3D, Code Assistant, Copywriting, Productivity, SEO, ... Non AI Tools)
Pricing model: Free / Freemium / Open Source / Paid / Contact for Pricing
A unique, originally written tool description (do not paste site copy)
workflow: Fill the form (name, email, tool name/URL/category/pricing, unique description)
Submit — 'Submit Your AI Tool Now!' button
Wait 1–2 weeks for review; notification of acceptance per FAQ
watchFor: Inflated marketing claims on page ('millions of AI users', '0M+ page views' placeholders) — temper traffic expectations
Unique-content requirement is the main rejection risk — write fresh copy
The submit page serves compressed/binary content to plain fetches; use a browser
Category list is huge — pick the most specific fit
countsAsLive: The tool has a published detail page on ai-hunter.io under its chosen category
unknowns: Whether accepted listings get a dofollow link
Whether rejected submissions get any notification
